title: Move host lead policy into GLOBAL and install it by release
body:
Claude hooks, ~/.claude/skills/krn-*, the codex-worker wrapper and lead bin scripts are untracked host files with no review path; stale copies in ~/.agents/skills are visible to Codex; install-release.sh and lead.sh ship hand-roll steps that krn install and krn ship own; krn host-lock locks are per repository. Operator 2026-10-28: move this policy into GLOBAL.
Acceptance: the policy files live in GLOBAL, are exported and installed by a sealed release, stale copies are removed, the seal and install flow uses native krn install and krn ship, and host-lock serializes host-wide.
